items.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF Loses $2.8 Billion in Eight Consecutive Trading Sessions
items.summary: Key takeaways US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded net outflows in eight straight sessions from November 17 to 27, totaling about $3.44 billion. BlackRock’s IBIT accounted for about $2.79 billion of that, roughly 81%. Friday’s shortened session still saw $389 million leave the funds, including $327.2 million from IBIT. items.title: Solana News: Developers Issue Urgent Upgrade Notice to Mainnet Validators
items.summary: Key takeaways Anza told Solana mainnet operators, staked and unstaked, to install Agave validator client v4.4.2 immediately. items.title: Trump Crypto News: World Liberty Financial Sells $20 Million in Ethereum Assets, Data Shows
items.summary: Key takeaways A wallet linked to World Liberty Financial sold 10,600 WETH and 1,378 mETH for about $20.06 million. Proceeds went into about $17.58 million USDC and $2.48 million USD1, the project’s own stablecoin. On-chain analyst Ember estimates a cost of $3,244 per ETH against a disposal value near $1,655, implying a loss of about $19.26 million. items.title: How PrimeXBT’s TradingView Integration Helps Traders Navigate Always-on Crypto Markets
items.summary: Bitcoin can move sharply overnight, during a weekend or while a trader is away from their screen. By the time they check the price again, a level they were watching may already have been broken. That is why alerts, technical indicators and tools for testing strategies have become important for monitoring price movements, analysing volatility and making informed trading decisions. items.title: Bitcoin Whales Accumulate $7.4 Billion in BTC, Breaking a Nine Year Pattern
items.summary: Key takeaways Balances in Bitcoin addresses holding 1,000 to 10,000 BTC rose by 121,117 BTC from September 30 to November 21, worth about $7.4 billion at a reference price of $61,000. Bitcoin fell 29.5% over the same period. This group reduced its holdings in seven of the previous nine fourth quarters. items.title: Zcash Developers Race to Secure Crypto. Can Quantum Computing Break Bitcoin?
items.summary: Key takeaways Zcash development team Zakura (November 26) called for accelerated retirement of the older Sapling privacy pool, which it estimated held about 400,000 ZEC. A November 27 dashboard snapshot showed about 306,684 ZEC still in Sapling, though that does not prove the warning prompted anyone to move funds. items.title: Ethereum’s Co-Founder Takes On Crypto’s Next Security Threat. Who Is Vitalik Buterin?
items.summary: Key takeaways Vitalik Buterin’s November 26 essay argues that crypto security must extend to the physical chips inside devices, summed up as “Not your silicon, not your keys.” He wants manufacturers to publish physical chip layouts (GDS files) so investigators can compare real hardware against the design. items.title: Monero’s Delisting Nightmare Continues: XMR Price Plunges 15%
items.summary: Key takeaways Monero fell about 15% on Thursday, from $525.36 to $446.54 per BitInfoCharts, after KuCoin announced it will delist XMR. KuCoin will end all four XMR spot pairs on November 30 at 08:00 UTC; deposits are already suspended and withdrawals stay open until December 31. XMR will also stop being accepted as collateral for VIP loans, so borrowers may need to add other collateral to avoid liquidation.
